diagnosis: **Diagnosis: open question OPEN W4, ticket `issues/20261008-quarry-difftest-widened-shapes-under-open-r2-and-w4.md`.** An absent `upsert` (in `run` or a prelude step) whose insert arm puts a unique `tag` held by a row the viewer cannot read.
